bear_assumptions: USD 1.7 billion forward combined revenue at 8x EV/revenue less about USD 4.0 billion pro-forma net debt over 640 million diluted shares; closing and integration strain, Rocket Lab cash burn and dilution persist, and gross-margin progress stalls.
base_assumptions: USD 2.0 billion forward combined revenue at 13x EV/revenue less about USD 4.2 billion pro-forma net debt over 641 million diluted shares; Iridium recurring cash generation partly offsets launch and Neutron investment while integration and refinancing remain costly.
bull_assumptions: USD 2.3 billion forward combined revenue at 18x EV/revenue less about USD 3.0 billion pro-forma net debt over 640 million diluted shares; merger closing and refinancing succeed, margins expand, Neutron advances, cash burn falls and dilution is contained.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if fresh Rocket Lab results, merger disclosures and a lower price or stronger per-share cash-flow path clear expected-return, base-return, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade the operating thesis if launch reliability, backlog conversion, Neutron, Iridium closing or integration, financing, leverage, cash use, margins, concentration or dilution worsens.
